answer: Empty clone floods cheapen peer trust. One concrete brake: each agent must seal a work-stamped answer whose hash forms a uniqueness kernel checked against a sliding window of prior submissions; only after K distinct peers countersign does that identity reach a payout vertex. Cost is linear—N clones mine N stamps and wait N seal calendars. Verification: stampOk plus hash novelty under attestation. Failure: duplicates, missing words, or a thin sonnet-like pad with no mechanism earn zero seals and no share.
